title: Sources: Axel Springer CEO Mathias Döpfner proposed joining a bid for TikTok's European business over lunch with Charles Kushner, the US ambassador to France (Financial Times)
summary: Financial Times: Sources: Axel Springer CEO Mathias Döpfner proposed joining a bid for TikTok's European business over lunch with Charles Kushner, the US ambassador to France — Axel Springer boss Mathias Döpfner raised idea over lunch with US ambassador to France Charles Kushner.
